title: Design System: Guilders Limited — The Platform Standard

display-section.purpose: Page H1s and band headings. clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem), -0.03em.

display-sub.purpose: Section and division headings. clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2rem), -0.02em. Card headings use text-lg/text-xl; stats use text-2xl and 1.75rem.

body.purpose: Paragraphs 1rem-1.25rem relaxed leading; checklist items 15px; UI small copy 0.875rem.

label.purpose: Small green semibold sentence-case labels — the Mono signature. Never uppercase-tracked.

shadows.name: card-ui
shadows.purpose: UI cards resting on the canvas. Offset + blur, never a zero-offset halo.

motion.name: card-rise
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: hero cards rise 14px and fade in, staggered 80ms/220ms. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover color/border transitions on links, buttons, cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid green CTA. White text on #0b6e43, hover deepens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #0b6e43; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #095c38; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b6e43; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button: ink text, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; color: #0a1f18; border: 1px solid #e5ece8; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; text-decoration: none; background: #ffffff; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #0b6e43; }

components.name: UI Card
components.description: The signature visual: a white operational-artifact card (tracking, terminal, order, lease, portfolio).
components.css: .ds-card-ui { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5ece8; border-radius: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(10 31 24 / 0.05), 0 12px 32px -12px rgb(10 31 24 / 0.18); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Rounded-full mint-deep chip with green semibold text: In transit, Paid, Delivered.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #ddefe6; color: #0b6e43; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; }

components.name: Arrow Link
components.description: Green semibold inline link with trailing arrow: 'More about logistics →'.
components.css: .ds-link-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; color: #0b6e43; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link-arrow:hover { color: #095c38; text-decoration: underline; }
